howToExport: Log in to PayPal on the web and go to Activity.
Click the Download icon and choose Custom; pick the date range (one request covers up to 12 months).
Select CSV as the format and keep the default fields (Date, Name, Type, Status, Currency, Gross, Fee, Net, Balance…).
Download the report once PayPal says it's ready (large ones take a while), then add it above.
knownQuirks: Authorization holds and unsettled payments appear with Status «Pending»; importing them counts money that never settled. The preset drops Pending, Denied and Voided rows.
Gross is the amount before PayPal's fee and Net is what reached your balance. QuickBooks reconciles against the PayPal balance, so the preset uses Net.
Amounts are quoted and carry thousands separators ("1,250.00"), which trips up QuickBooks' upload. The preset writes plain 1250.00.
Multi-currency payments add rows in each currency; the cleaner keeps one currency per file so the QuickBooks PayPal account stays consistent.
